counting_rule: Count each row once in each original integration-results/**/summary.json, keyed by artifact, summary path, suite and mode. Result JSON files and repeated logs are not additional processes.
scope: Existing GitHub correctness artifacts only. No probes, benchmarks, .NET commands or new correctness tests executed.

selection.archive_member_prefix: <architecture>-<configuration>/; original relative member path retained afterwards
excluded_payloads: actual .cs files and duplicate source trees
